cases.name: two files, three hunks
cases.patch:
diff --git a/greeting.py b/greeting.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..e69de29
--- /dev/null
+++ b/greeting.py
@@ -0,0 +1,2 @@
+def hello():
+    return "Hello!"
diff --git a/app.py b/app.py
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/app.py
+++ b/app.py
@@ -10,3 +10,4 @@ def main():
 keep_one
-old_line
+new_line
 keep_two
@@ -40,2 +41,3 @@ def other():
 context
+added

cases.name: a moved hunk keeps its id
cases.patch:
diff --git a/app.py b/app.py
@@ -80,3 +91,4 @@ def something_else():
 keep_one
-old_line
+new_line
 keep_two

cases.name: bare ranges, unicode, and a no-newline marker
cases.patch:
diff --git a/notes.md b/notes.md
--- a/notes.md
+++ b/notes.md
@@ -1 +1 @@
-café
+café au lait
\ No newline at end of file

cases.name: a malformed header is not a hunk
cases.patch:
diff --git a/app.py b/app.py
@@ not a hunk header @@
 ctx
@@ -1,1 +1,2 @@
 ctx
+added

note: Shared by bridge/src/diff.rs and spa/src/core/diff.js. Regenerate both suites together.
